info.title: Aurora Hotels — Hotel Management System API
info.description: Versioned REST API for authentication, bookings, guests, rooms, invoices, payments, and reports (FR-API-001). All responses use consistent API Resource transformers; all errors share a single {"error": {code, message, errors?}} envelope (FR-API-003).

post.summary: Exchange credentials for a Sanctum API token

mfa_code.description: Required if the account has MFA enabled

get.summary: Show an invoice (folio) with its charges and payments

post.summary: Record a payment against an invoice (cash, POS, or bank transfer only — gateway methods are webhook-driven)

get.summary: Occupancy rate for a branch on a given date
Revenue for a branch over a date range, broken down by charge type
List room types for a branch
Check room availability for a date range

sanctum.description: Sanctum personal access token. Send as `Authorization: Bearer {token}`. Tokens are scoped by ability (FR-API-004) — see the abilities returned at login.
